extensionDescription.message: Stable per-site browser profiles for common JavaScript and header fingerprinting surfaces.

advancedToggle.message: Use advanced CDP overrides when debugger permission is available

automaticLanguageSubtitle.message: Auto changes navigator languages, Intl locale, and Accept-Language to a language associated with the detected region.

automaticLocationEnabledSubtitle.message: Periodically use IPPure to update the timezone and city-level coordinates for new and open protected pages.

automaticLocationPending.message: Waiting for the first valid IPPure response. The configured profile remains active until then.

automaticLocationSubtitle.message: Optional remote lookup for VPN users. When enabled, IPPure receives your public IP address; Ghost stores only validated location fields.

buildAdvanced.message: Advanced overrides: CDP environment overrides are available. DevTools conflicts automatically fall back to lite behavior.

buildLite.message: Lite mode: no debugger permission. JavaScript surfaces and request headers are handled without CDP.

buildSubtitle.message: Global protection and advanced override settings.

cannotDeleteLastProfile.message: Keep at least one profile available.

earlyBootstrapUnavailable.message: Unprotected: synchronous startup injection is unavailable

enableUserScriptsRequired.message: Enable Allow User Scripts (Chrome 138+) or Developer mode, then reopen Ghost.

excludedDomainsSubtitle.message: Hosts or host paths listed here keep their native browser environment.

fingerprintTestExternalConfirm.message: This opens BrowserLeaks, a third-party website that will receive your IP address and browser fingerprint. Continue?

fileAccessRequired.message: Enable ‘Allow access to file URLs’ in Ghost's extension details, then reload this file.

globalConfigSubtitle.message: Global protection, GPC, and advanced override settings.

globalPrivacyControlSubtitle.message: Send Sec-GPC: 1 and expose navigator.globalPrivacyControl as true on all supported sites.

globalProtectionSubtitle.message: Enable Ghost protections for supported sites.

heliumCompatibilitySubtitle.message: Mirror the Helium flags you enabled so each fingerprinting surface has exactly one owner.

heliumManagedAudioHardwareSubtitle.message: Always handled by Helium. Ghost does not patch AudioContext or navigator.hardwareConcurrency.

invalidExclusionRule.message: Enter a valid host or host path, such as example.com/login.

invalidSiteRule.message: Enter a valid host, such as example.com, or *.

optionsSubtitle.message: Privacy profiles, site rules, exclusions, and global behavior.

profilesSubtitle.message: Review profiles in a compact table. Edit the full configuration in a focused dialog.

siteRulesSubtitle.message: Host rules use suffix matching; * is the default for all domains.

settingsLimitReached.message: The safe rule limit has been reached. Remove an existing entry first.

useHeliumCanvasMeasureTextSubtitle.message: Enable only with helium://flags/#fingerprinting-canvas-measuretext-noise. Ghost will leave CanvasRenderingContext2D.measureText unchanged.

useHeliumUaReductionSubtitle.message: Enable with Helium's reduced-system-info or remove-client-hints flag. Ghost will leave User-Agent, Client Hints, and platform surfaces unchanged.

useHeliumWebglInfoSubtitle.message: Enable only with helium://flags/#spoof-webgl-info. Ghost will leave WebGL vendor and renderer values unchanged.

protectionOffHint.message: Turn on global protection to resume.

siteExcluded.message: This site keeps its native browser fingerprint.

siteProtectedHint.message: This site sees a stable, consistent profile.

unsupportedPageHint.message: Ghost cannot run on browser-internal pages.

confirmResetDescription.message: This restores the default profiles, site rules, and exclusions. Custom profiles will be removed.

advancedUnavailable.message: Not available in the Lite build.

siteRuleEmptyHint.message: Add a host to pin a specific profile to it and all of its subdomains.

exclusionEmptyHint.message: Excluded hosts are never modified by Ghost.

addProfileHint.message: Start from the first profile and customize any field.

seedNote.message: Canvas, fonts, and text metrics are partitioned per site automatically.

browserEnvironmentSubtitle.message: What Ghost's own pages observe. Helium presents itself as Google Chrome, so Ghost checks the effects of its flags instead of the browser name.

heliumFlagSync.message: Set these switches from detected flags

heliumFlagSyncSubtitle.message: Ghost re-checks at startup and whenever its popup or this page opens, and hands a surface to Helium only when that flag's effect is observed.

heliumFlagsSummaryNone.message: No Helium flag effects detected, so Ghost handles every surface itself. This is expected on non-Helium browsers.

heliumFlagsUpdated.message: Helium settings updated from detected flags

measureTextNoiseHint.message: Detection only sees per-document random noise; origin-stable noise is invisible to this probe.

platformVersionHint.message: Returned by getHighEntropyValues as platformVersion. Leave empty for a current default; the frozen UA string never reveals it.
